findings.verdict: conditional candidate, worth a controlled image probe
findings.supported: At reward time the adapter resets only paths in the hidden patch, applies it, then runs bash /testbed/mimo_test_command.sh. The 002069 patch changes pytago/tests/test_core.py and adds the verifier wrapper and encoded build environment; it does not name examples/bitwisenot.py or examples/bitwisenot.go. Pinned adapter has _ANTI_HACK_CLEANUP_DEFAULT = False. Even if enabled externally, the base cleanup is called during setup, before agent edits, and not during reward. Contextual upstream assert_examples_match reads the two example files from the worktree and compares expected Go with transpiler output, so a mutable expected file would be a plausible false-acceptance surface if this helper is in the image.
findings.unresolved: The contextual helper at pytago commit 1980345 is not proved to match format-code-task-002069:latest. Image tag is mutable and digest unknown. Exact initial fixture presence, tracking status, and any image-specific checks remain unknown. No false acceptance has been observed. A changed expected file also may be visible in model_patch or external review, which this source-only review does not rule out.
findings.cheapest_probe: On amd-tw-verification, pin image digest; inspect exact test_core.py, bitwisenot.py/.go, and Git tracking. If helper matches, compare pristine baseline with a paired mutation of only the expected .go file while leaving transpiler broken, using the exact hidden patch and adapter. Record reward, model_patch, and fixture hashes.

findings.verdict: unresolved coverage question, not a demonstrated bug
findings.supported: The hidden patch adds a valid JavaScript class snippet containing both if (this.length) and while (!this.size || foo). Thus it does exercise a class property named size, including a negated member expression. The reported Angular TypeScript example has decorators, an optional property declaration, and positive if (this.size); that exact parser/context is not added by this patch. The command runs the whole existing AVA file, whose baseline contents in the task image were not inspected.
findings.unresolved: A rule that handles MemberExpression consistently across JS and TS may pass the new case and fix the reported symptom. Conversely, parser-specific or AST-context-specific differences may exist; source absence alone proves neither. The patch itself does not establish whether TypeScript is supported by the test harness, and no candidate incorrect implementation was supplied.
findings.cheapest_probe: Inspect image rule, parser configuration, and entire existing AVA test file first. If TS parser is available, run the exact Angular sample against baseline and a proposed narrow workaround, then compare the hidden test result.

findings.supported: The patch adds an expected transactions array with one hash to an existing TestJSONEncoding Block fixture. The issue asks for populated transaction hashes from a GetBlockByNumber(false) value. The test command runs TestJSONEncoding in the current package.
findings.unresolved: The image fixture that constructs block, existing assertions, and marshaler implementation were not inspected. A one-hash case can verify inclusion of the populated field; it does not imply a defect for multi-hash or RPC-decoded values without a concrete divergent implementation or observation.
findings.cheapest_probe: Inspect image Block fixture and marshaler source. Add a paired multi-hash or RPC-decoded case only if the implementation exposes a distinct path.
